data-for-hand-built-transactions-refused.text: Data for hand-built transactions refused by the deployed validators.
Issue 764, first slice. The records the check produces and the invariants over them. Modules are in the modules model.

invariants.text: six-rows: the table has exactly one refusal row and one control row per case.

refusal-means-script-failure: a refusal row passes only when the node outcome is refused, the failure is an explicit failure of the code of the named validator and not an exhausted budget, the blamed script is the one the case names, and the chain's own record does not hold the transaction.
control-means-accepted-and-recorded: a control row passes only when the node outcome is accepted and the chain's own record holds the transaction.
one-fact: a refusal and its control differ in exactly the altered fact; the table names it.
assertions-can-fail: each of the two judging assertions is run on the other role's receipt and must fail there.
no-verdict-without-receipt: a missing or unreadable receipt makes its row fail, never an absent row.
